en: I took off the coat at home.
I didn't take off my shoes at the door.
You took off your shirt in the room.
You didn't take off the cap from your head.
You (f.) took down the picture from the wall.
You (f.) didn't take off the watch from your hand.
He removed the paper from the book.
He didn't remove the trash from the house.
She took off her ring yesterday.
She didn't take the plate off the table.
We moved the chairs out of the kitchen.
We didn't remove the carpet from the floor.
You (pl.) took the keys out of the door.
You (pl.) didn't take the blanket off the bed.
They removed the pictures from the wall.
They didn't remove the bread from the table.
I always take off my shoes at home.
I don't take off my ring.
You take off the coat at work.

lat: nta ma kat7iyedsh s-sa3a b l-lil
en: You don't take off the watch at night.
You (f.) take the paper out of the drawer.

lat: nti ma kat7iydish l-fular dyalek f d-dar
ar: نتي ما كتحيديش الفولار ديالك فالدار
en: You (f.) don't take off your scarf at home.
He removes the dust from the table.

lat: huwa ma kay7iyedsh l-kaskita f l-qism
en: He doesn't take off the cap in the classroom.
She clears the dishes from the table.

lat: hiya ma kat7iyedsh l-kabbot dyalha f l-biru
ar: هي ما كتحيدش الكابوط ديالها فالبيرو
en: She doesn't take off her coat in the office.
We take out the trash every morning.

ar: حنا ما كنحيدوش الخس من الشلاضة
en: We don't remove the lettuce from the salad.
You (pl.) are removing the chairs from the room.

lat: ntuma ma kat7iydush l-wraq mn t-tbla
ar: نتوما ما كتحيدوش الوراق من الطبلة
en: You (pl.) don't remove the papers from the table.
They remove the old clothes from the closet.

lat: huma ma kay7iydush l-khwatem dyalhum f l-khdma
ar: هما ما كيحيدوش الخواتم ديالهم فالخدمة
en: They don't take off their rings at work.
I am going to take off the jacket now.

lat: ma ghadish n7iyed s-sa3a mn ydi
ar: ما غاديش نحيد الساعة من يدي
en: I am not going to take off the watch from my hand.
You are going to take off the cap in the room.

lat: ma ghadish t7iyed s-sbbat f l-bab
en: You are not going to take off the shoes at the door.

lat: nti ghadi t7iydi t-tswira mn l-7ayt
ar: نتي غادي تحيدي التصويرة من الحيط
en: You (f.) are going to take down the picture from the wall.

lat: nti ma ghadish t7iydi l-khatem dyalek
ar: نتي ما غاديش تحيدي الخاتم ديالك
en: You (f.) are not going to take off your ring.

lat: huwa ghadi y7iyed l-qamija dyalu daba
ar: هو غادي يحيد القميجة ديالو دابا
en: He is going to take off his shirt now.

lat: huwa ma ghadish y7iyed z-zbel l-yum
ar: هو ما غاديش يحيد الزبل اليوم
en: He is not going to take out the trash today.

lat: hiya ghadi t7iyed l-ma3en mn t-tbla
ar: هي غادي تحيد الماعن من الطبلة
en: She is going to clear the dishes from the table.

lat: hiya ma ghadish t7iyed l-kabbot dyalha
ar: هي ما غاديش تحيد الكابوط ديالها
en: She is not going to take off her coat.

lat: ghadi n7iydu l-krasi mn l-kuzina ghedda
ar: غادي نحيدو الكراسي من الكوزينة غدا
en: We are going to move the chairs out of the kitchen tomorrow.

lat: ma ghadish n7iydu z-zerbiya mn l-ard
ar: ما غاديش نحيدو الزربية من الارض
en: We are not going to remove the carpet from the floor.

lat: ntuma ghadi t7iydu s-swart mn l-bab
ar: نتوما غادي تحيدو السوارت من الباب
en: You (pl.) are going to take the keys out of the door.

lat: ma ghadish t7iydu l-wraq mn l-mejjer
ar: ما غاديش تحيدو الوراق من المجر
en: You (pl.) are not going to take the papers out of the drawer.

lat: huma ghadi y7iydu t-tsawer mn l-7ayt
ar: هما غادي يحيدو التصاور من الحيط
en: They are going to take down the pictures from the wall.

lat: huma ma ghadish y7iydu l-khobz mn t-tbla
ar: هما ما غاديش يحيدو الخبز من الطبلة
en: They are not going to remove the bread from the table.
